title: Servers with large total database size
description: For each server_name, calculate total database size and keep servers with total_size_gb of at least 100. Return exactly two columns: server_name, total_size_gb. Sort by total_size_gb DESC, then server_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT server_name, SUM(size_gb) AS total_size_gb
FROM databases
hints: Calculate the sum separately for each server_name.
A condition on SUM belongs in HAVING.
solution_explanation: This task checks SUM, grouping, and a threshold on an aggregate.
